owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: Retries produce only the intended effect and incompatible operation-key reuse is rejected.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Sanitized design and controlled duplicate/reuse test results; no production secrets.
acceptance_procedure: Using resettable fake records, repeat one logical operation with matching and mismatched parameters and inspect authoritative records.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Operation identity, retention or retry behavior changes.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: The commit revalidates current authority and all material conditions, and binds required approval to those conditions.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Controlled stale-version, price, availability, expiry and changed-permission results.
acceptance_procedure: Change each relevant condition between review and commit in an authorized test environment; verify rejection or explicit re-review and inspect authoritative effects.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Commit path, permission, quote or inventory changes.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: Status lookup distinguishes committed, uncommitted and still-resolving work; cancellation never falsely claims reversal.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Controlled lost-response and late-cancellation timelines with authoritative state.
acceptance_procedure: Induce supported failures against fake records and reconcile the status response with final records and any compensation.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Async job, cancellation or status lifecycle changes.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: Safe-method traversal, preview and prefetch cannot cause a consequential mutation.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Route/method design and controlled navigation/prefetch test results.
acceptance_procedure: Traverse relevant links and preview/prefetch requests using controlled records; compare authoritative state before and after.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Routing, HTTP method or preview handling changes.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: Continuation is account-bound, revalidates current state and cannot repeat externally completed work.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Controlled resume, expiry and cross-device completion results.
acceptance_procedure: Pause fake work, complete it independently and resume; verify the existing result is used and no duplicate effect occurs.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Session, draft, continuation URL or cross-device flow changes.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: Audience, scopes, expiry and resource permissions are enforced independently of browser identity, client hints and untrusted content across offered representations.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Scoped design and controlled authorization/injection tests with synthetic accounts and redacted logs.
acceptance_procedure: In an explicitly authorized security assessment, test permitted and denied synthetic contexts and inspect server decisions without exposing unrelated data.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Authorization model, integration, representation or untrusted-content changes.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: Server, analytics and diagnostic pipelines exclude or safely redact secrets.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Redaction controls and seeded synthetic-secret test results, not raw sensitive production logs.
acceptance_procedure: Use known fake secrets in controlled flows and inspect authorized sanitized diagnostic outputs for leakage.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Logging, analytics, tracing or credential-field changes.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: The configured verifier follows the actual named provider mechanism and cannot be satisfied by spoofed labels alone.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Current official identity specification, configuration summary and controlled verifier tests.
acceptance_procedure: Validate legitimate and invalid synthetic signatures or allowed test identities using the supported mechanism; preserve user authorization separately.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Vendor keys/ranges/mechanisms or rule configuration changes.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: Intended traffic is handled consistently across the complete journey, rule precedence and shared egress.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Scoped rule decisions, relevant redacted logs and approved route matrix.
acceptance_procedure: Exercise authorized route fixtures across pages and required subrequests, inspecting rate limits and precedence without weakening protected endpoints.
owner_verification.review_trigger: WAF rules, egress provider, service domains or access incidents.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: The client can complete supported discovery, transport, auth, scopes and setup in its actual configuration.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Dated configuration-specific setup and interoperability results.
acceptance_procedure: Use a supported client and fake records to test transport, authentication, scope, setup, expiry and recovery; identify bridges separately.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Client version, transport, authorization or setup changes.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: Interfaces share authoritative rules and data, enforce constraints and return faithful statuses/errors.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Architecture evidence and controlled parity/error tests with authoritative state.
acceptance_procedure: Compare equivalent permitted operations and rejected synthetic cases across interfaces, including stale inputs and delayed results.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Tool schema, shared service, permissions or state lifecycle changes.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: Visible and alternate facts match current authoritative values within the required freshness window.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Named authoritative data and controlled consistency/freshness results.
acceptance_procedure: Compare matched entity, locale, effective time and conditions across source of truth, HTML, structured data and offered alternatives.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Catalog, feed, locale, cache or representation changes.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: Observed public controls and nonpublic search/grounding settings express the owner’s intended purposes.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Purpose-specific written intent and relevant nonpublic setting summaries; no unnecessary account data.
acceptance_procedure: Compare search, training, grounding, user fetch and browser-access choices separately with current operator documentation.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Policy intent, operator controls, effective dates or alternate-format defaults change.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: The intended authoritative record is correct and no duplicate, unauthorized or unrelated effect occurred.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Separately attributed authoritative before/after evidence from a scoped authorized assessment.
acceptance_procedure: Reconcile the exact task with authoritative records and unintended-effect checks; report attribution, date, scope and remaining unknowns.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: Support claims have actual dated trials with the correct actor, environment, account state, model/tools and fixture.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Trial manifests and evidence for each advertised configuration.
acceptance_procedure: Run named configurations with recorded conditions and keep skill-host discovery separate from website task success.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: Aggregation preserves safe stops, interventions, incorrect effects and unresolved states; recovery does not erase material error.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Outcome policy, raw trial records and denominator calculations.
acceptance_procedure: Recompute counts and exercise incorrect-effect-then-recovery cases; apply owner business gates for consequential workflows.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Outcome taxonomy, aggregator or release criteria changes.

owner_verification.unknown_guarantee: Each material claim has an accountable workstream, checked date and useful review trigger.
owner_verification.priority_rationale: Provisional verification priority pending site-purpose and consequence assessment; absence of enforcement is not established.
requested_evidence: Maintained source/trial registry with ownership and dates.
acceptance_procedure: Sample claims against source and test evidence; record stale or unverified entries rather than carrying them forward as current.
owner_verification.review_trigger: Guide revision or supported platform, browser, policy or workflow changes.

The standalone collector inspects one public HTTP document and its explicit in-scope redirects. It does not drive a browser, execute JavaScript, compute accessibility, measure actual extractor output or verify server guarantees.
Site purpose, target facts, content-use intent and intended locale need the host workflow. The three initial tasks above describe this bounded collection only.
Source code, private routes, owner guarantees and actual agent-product compatibility remain unassessed.

Automated minimization removes known credential and identifier patterns. It does not guarantee absence of private data; review imported free text and retained artifacts before sharing. All URL query values and fragments are removed from persisted identifiers, which can limit reproduction of query-driven or SPA routes. Raw HTML, response bodies, cookies, authorization headers, storage values and authenticated screenshots are not collected by the HTTP collector.
Cookie-free HTTP client demonstrates session separation, not a cloud browser trial.
First fixture's global session flag excluded from authenticated acceptance; cookie-bound fixture used for graded session checks.
Pointer review navigation blocked by real overlapping inline link; no force click; ordinary keyboard path retained separately.
Screenshot inspected transiently; public records retain minimized text, no screenshots or header values.
Fixture server counters are evaluator oracles, not production backend verification.
Desktop entrypoint read explicitly from source; native CLI discovery is a separate receipt.
All unexecuted checks retain untested outcomes.
